verses.text: This is the message the LORD gave to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah. It came during the time when Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah.
"I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth," says the LORD.

"I will sweep away people and animals. I will sweep away the birds of the sky and the fish of the sea, and the idols that make the wicked fall. I will wipe out humanity from the face of the earth," says the LORD.
"I will reach out my hand against Judah and against everyone who lives in Jerusalem. I will wipe out every trace of Baal from this place, and even the names of the idol priests and the pagan priests.
I will wipe out those who bow down on their roofs to worship the stars, and those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Molech.
I will wipe out those who have turned back from following the LORD and who neither look for the LORD nor ask for his guidance."
Be silent before the Lord GOD, because the day of the LORD is near. The LORD has prepared a sacrifice. He has set apart his invited guests.
"On the day of the LORD's sacrifice, I will punish the officials and the king's sons and all who dress in foreign clothes.
On that day I will punish all who avoid stepping on the threshold, who fill their master's house with violence and lies.
"On that day," says the LORD, "a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, wailing from the New Quarter, and a loud crash from the hills.
Wail, you who live in the market district! All your merchants will be wiped out. All who trade with silver will be destroyed.
At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those who are lazy and comfortable, like wine left to sit too long. They think, 'The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.'
Their wealth will be stolen, and their houses will be destroyed. They will build houses but not live in them. They will plant vineyards but not drink the wine."
The great day of the LORD is near. It is near and coming very fast. Listen! The day of the LORD will be bitter. Even the strongest warrior will cry out bitterly.
That day will be a day of anger, a day of trouble and distress, a day of ruin and destruction, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
a day of trumpet blasts and battle cries against the fortified cities and the high towers.
"I will bring such distress on people that they will walk around like the blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their bodies like dung."

Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to save them on the day of the LORD's anger. The whole earth will be burned up by the fire of his jealous anger. He will bring a sudden and terrible end to everyone who lives on the earth.
